title: 06. A Day in the Rainbow Class
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: On a fresh, bright morning, Kongi arrived at the Rainbow Class carrying a box of crayons. I'll draw a picture diary of my whole day! Kongi was so excited that those cheek pouches puffed up. The Rainbow Class is fun!

First came the cozy book corner. Kongi and Hori opened a picture book side by side. Wow, there's a dinosaur! Hori pointed, and Kongi's eyes grew wide, enjoying every bit of the story. The Rainbow Class is fun!
Next came the Rainbow Class garden. Kongi and Bori watered the plants with a watering can. Drink up and grow tall! Little green leaves peeked out of the soil. The Rainbow Class is fun!
Something red was dangling between the leaves. Oh! The cherry tomatoes are red! Kongi jumped and clapped. They had grown with the water the friends gave them. The Rainbow Class is fun!
Rumble, rumble! Their tummies said it was lunchtime. Kongi munched with full cheek pouches, enjoying warm rice and cherry tomatoes. Food tastes even better with friends! The Rainbow Class is fun!
After lunch came block play. Together with Toto and Dubu, Kongi built a castle that seemed to reach the sky. Wow! Our castle is so tall! Dubu barked and wagged a tail. The Rainbow Class is fun!
Now it was time for music! Kongi shook a tambourine, Hori beat a drum, and Bori jingled bells. They sang and swayed together. La, la, la! The Rainbow Class song! The Rainbow Class is fun!
Last came outdoor play. Kongi and the friends zoomed down the slide and ran across the grass. Cool wind brushed their cheeks. Catch me if you can! Laughter filled the yard. The Rainbow Class is fun!
Before going home, Kongi drew the promised picture diary. Books, watering plants, red tomatoes, lunch, a tall block castle, and music time all came alive on the paper in crayon. Finished!

On the way home under the sunset, Kongi hugged the picture diary close. The whole day was right there inside it. Tomorrow will be fun, too! Humming happily, Kongi skipped home. Every day together is precious and bright.
